title: Contradictory wants: central + spacious + cheap
persona: Jason, 29, works in tech, high expectations, first serious rental search.
situation: Wants Orchard/CBD location, a big place, and a low price — all at once. Needs the agent to surface the trade-off and help him prioritise.

turns.content: I want a 2-bedroom in the Orchard area, at least 900 sqft, for under $3,000.
What do you mean there's nothing? There must be something.
Okay… what would I have to give up to make this work?
Fine, I care most about staying central. Show me the best I can get near town for that budget.
